explanation.title: How Your Level is Calculated
explanation.intro: Your climbing level is computed automatically from your ON-WALL session history.
explanation.algorithm: Average of your best {{top}} boulders from the last {{days}} days (minimum {{min}} required).
explanation.max: The highest grade you've sent in the time window.
explanation.normalization: Grades from different gyms are normalized using V-scale as a common baseline, so you get an accurate level even if you climb at multiple gyms.
explanation.dualFormat: Your level is always displayed in both V-Scale and Font formats for easy reference.

difficultyExplanation.title: Gym Difficulty Index Explained
difficultyExplanation.baseline: Baseline = your average max grade across all gyms
difficultyExplanation.bias: Bias = difference between gym's avg and your baseline
difficultyExplanation.samples: Based on all boulder logs in selected period

zonesExplanation.title: Development Zones Explained
zonesExplanation.intro: Zones categorize your climbing volume based on difficulty relative to your current level:
zonesExplanation.comfort: Comfort: Grades well below your max. Good for warm-up and technique practice.
zonesExplanation.growth: Growth: Grades near your limit. The sweet spot for progression and skill building.
zonesExplanation.limit: Limit: Grades at or beyond your max. Challenges your physical ceiling.
zonesExplanation.computed: Zones are computed from ON-WALL sessions using grade normalization based on your climbing history.
zonesExplanation.painNote: Sessions with pain are marked and should be interpreted cautiously.
